prompt.zh: 给一个冻结的 `nn.Linear` 加上 LoRA。测试会检查四件事，即初始化时输出与原层相同、只有 A 和 B 可训练、它能学会一个隐藏的秩为 2 的权重改动，以及合并后得到输出相同的普通线性层。
prompt.en: Add LoRA to a frozen `nn.Linear`. The tests check four things, namely that the output equals that of the original layer at initialization, that only A and B are trainable, that it can learn a hidden weight change of rank 2, and that merging gives an ordinary linear layer with identical outputs.

hints.zh: 冻结用 `for p in self.base.parameters(): p.requires_grad_(False)`。
hints.en: Freeze with `for p in self.base.parameters(): p.requires_grad_(False)`.

hints.zh: `nn.Linear` 的权重形状是 `(out, in)`，所以 `A` 是 `(r, in)`，`B` 是 `(out, r)`。前向中 LoRA 的部分是 `x @ self.A.T @ self.B.T`，完整的修正矩阵是 `self.B @ self.A`。
hints.en: The weight of `nn.Linear` has shape `(out, in)`, so `A` is `(r, in)` and `B` is `(out, r)`. The LoRA part of the forward pass is `x @ self.A.T @ self.B.T` and the full correction matrix is `self.B @ self.A`.

hints.zh: 合并时新建一个 `nn.Linear`，在 `torch.no_grad()` 下把 `base.weight + delta_weight()` 和偏置复制进去。
hints.en: For merging create a new `nn.Linear` and, under `torch.no_grad()`, copy `base.weight + delta_weight()` and the bias into it.
